details: Our project is an app that displays topics about our planet, such as deforestation, sea level, global temperature, and similar issues. We used AI to create the app, and we used some NASA data. We created this app so that people can generate statistics on factors that may occur in the future. We considered the following factors: global temperature, sea level, Arctic sea ice, carbon dioxide, burned area in Brazil, and deforestation in the Amazon. We used accessible language, with audio, captions, and images. We used NASA data in an AI, and it generated the app. We used AI in the audio, images, code, and captions.
